'''Colstev''' was a small, rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Stewjon system/Legends|Stewjon system]]. It was the homeworld of [[Jin-Rio Akabi]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Colstev is named after Stephen Colbert, the host of ''The Colbert Report'', which was a sister show of ''The Daily Show'', hosted by Jon Stewart after whom [[Stewjon]] was named.
